title: State-Building in a Diverse Society
title_zh: 多元社会中的国家建设
title_primary: 多元社会中的国家建设
title_secondary: State-Building in a Diverse Society
authors: Ruth Carlitz, Ameet Morjaria, Joris Mueller, Philip Osafo-Kwaako
official: 官方在线 2022-12-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Diversity poses fundamental challenges to state-building and development. We study the effects of one of post-colonial Africa's largest policy experiments -the Tanzanian Ujamaa policywhich attempted to address these challenges. Ujamaa aimed to create a national identity and consolidate state authority by mandating a highly diverse population to live in planned villages, where children received political education. We combine differences in exposure to Ujamaa across space and age to identify long-term impacts of the policy. We show persistent, positive effects on national identity based on surveys and inter-ethnic marriages. We observe no systematic differences for cohorts that were above or below treatment-age during Ujamaa. Our preferred interpretation, supported by evidence that considers alternative hypotheses, is that changes to educational content drive our findings. Moreover, while Ujamaa contributed to establishing the Tanzanian state as a legitimate central authority, it appears to have lowered demands for democratic accountability.
abstract_zh: 多样性对国家建设和发展构成根本性挑战。我们研究了后殖民时代非洲最大规模的政策实验之一——坦桑尼亚的乌贾马政策——该政策旨在应对这些挑战。乌贾马试图通过强制高度多样化的民众居住于规划村庄，并在其中对儿童进行政治教育，来构建国家认同并巩固国家权威。我们结合了乌贾马政策在空间和年龄上的暴露差异，以识别该政策的长期影响。基于调查和跨族裔婚姻的数据，我们展示了该政策对国家认同具有持续且积极的影响。对于乌贾马时期处于或超过治疗年龄的队列，我们未观察到系统性差异。我们更倾向于的解释是，教育内容的改变驱动了我们的发现，这一解释得到了考虑替代假说的证据支持。此外，尽管乌贾马政策有助于确立坦桑尼亚国家作为合法中央权威的地位，但它似乎降低了对民主问责的要求。

title: Opportunistic Sovereign Default under a Credible Peg
title_zh: 可信盯住汇率制下的机会主义主权违约
title_primary: 可信盯住汇率制下的机会主义主权违约
title_secondary: Opportunistic Sovereign Default under a Credible Peg
authors: Joao Hernández
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: 官方在线 2026-08-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In the African Financial Community (CFA) franc zones, a credible euro peg coexists with external debt denominated largely in U.S. dollars: euro–dollar fluctuations, exogenous to these small economies, directly raise the domestic-currency burden of debt. Panel regressions show that such depreciations raise sovereign default intensity by roughly 9%. In these same high-default years, consumption does not fall—evidence against the insurance motive of standard default models. I explain both facts by extending the partial default framework of Arellano et al. (2023) with foreign-currency debt, exogenous exchange rate shocks, and government heterogeneity. Exogeneity changes the nature of default: governments default not for insurance but opportunistically, exploiting the valuation gap between the higher debt burden and the higher revenue from new borrowing, generating a short-run rise in consumption. A policy counterfactual finds leaving for a self-managed dollar peg welfare-neutral on the financial side: opportunistic default insures the mismatch so effectively that a country profits from devaluations whatever their source, so the arrangement’s value lies not in shielding the debt but in the exogenous-devaluation environment that makes default opportunistic.
abstract_zh: 在非洲金融共同体（CFA）法郎区，可信的欧元盯住汇率制度与主要以美元计价的外部债务并存：欧元兑美元汇率的波动，对这些小型经济体而言是外生的，直接加重了国内货币计价的债务负担。面板回归显示，此类贬值会使主权违约强度上升约9%。而在这些高违约年份中，消费并未下降——这与标准违约模型中的保险动机相悖。我通过扩展Arellano等人（2023）的部分违约框架，引入外币债务、外生汇率冲击及政府异质性，来解释这两个事实。外生性改变了违约的本质：政府违约并非出于保险目的，而是机会主义行为，利用更高债务负担与新增借款更高收入之间的估值缺口，从而在短期内推高消费。一项政策反事实分析发现，转向自我管理的美元盯住汇率制度在金融层面福利中性：机会主义违约如此有效地对冲了货币错配，以至于无论贬值源于何种因素，国家都能从中获利，因此该安排的价值不在于保护债务本身，而在于外生贬值环境使违约具有机会主义性质。

title: Does local government debt replacement affect corporate investment efficiency? Evidence from China
title_zh: 地方政府债务置换是否影响企业投资效率？来自中国的证据
title_primary: 地方政府债务置换是否影响企业投资效率？来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Does local government debt replacement affect corporate investment efficiency? Evidence from China
authors: Jing Yan, Chunyan Zhao, Xinyi Zheng, Yan Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Mitigating local government debt risks is essential for safeguarding economic and financial stability. As a key instrument of structural deleveraging, the local government debt replacement programme may generate important spillover effects on firms, yet its microeconomic consequences and transmission mechanisms remain underexplored. Using China’s first-round LGDR programme during 2015–2018 as a quasi-natural experiment and a sample covering 248 prefecture-level cities, this study employs an intensity-based difference-in-differences approach to examine the impact of local government debt replacement on corporate investment efficiency and its underlying mechanisms. The results show that local government debt replacement significantly improves corporate investment efficiency. Mechanism analyses provide evidence consistent with two potential channels: improvements in firms’ external financing conditions and internal managerial efficiency. Heterogeneity analyses further reveal that the positive effect is stronger for non-state-owned firms, technology-intensive firms, and firms operating in competitive industries. This study enriches the literature on the microeconomic effects of local debt governance policies and provides new evidence on how debt-risk mitigation policies improve resource allocation and investment efficiency at the firm level. KEYWORDS: Local government debt replacement corporate investment efficiency intensity DID quantile regression JEL CLASSIFICATION: G38 E65
abstract_zh: 化解地方政府债务风险对于维护经济金融稳定至关重要。作为结构性去杠杆的关键工具，地方政府债务置换计划可能对企业产生重要的溢出效应，但其微观经济后果及传导机制尚未得到充分探讨。本文以2015—2018年中国首轮地方政府债务置换计划作为准自然实验，利用覆盖248个地级市层面的样本，采用基于强度的双重差分方法，考察地方政府债务置换对企业投资效率的影响及其内在机制。研究结果表明，地方政府债务置换显著提升了企业投资效率。机制分析提供了与两条潜在渠道相一致的证据：企业外部融资条件的改善和内部管理效率的提升。异质性分析进一步揭示，对于非国有企业、技术密集型企业以及处于竞争性行业的企业而言，这一积极效应更为显著。本研究丰富了关于地方债务治理政策微观经济效应的文献，并为债务风险化解政策如何改善企业层面的资源配置与投资效率提供了新的证据。关键词：地方政府债务置换；企业投资效率；强度DID；分位数回归 JEL分类：G38；E65

title: External Finance in Emerging Markets and Developing Economies: A Tale of Differences in Vulnerabilities
title_zh: 新兴市场与发展中经济体的外部融资：脆弱性差异之鉴
title_primary: 新兴市场与发展中经济体的外部融资：脆弱性差异之鉴
title_secondary: External Finance in Emerging Markets and Developing Economies: A Tale of Differences in Vulnerabilities
authors: Dohan Kim, Gian Maria Milesi-Ferretti
official: 官方在线 2026-01-12 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Over the past two decades, many emerging market economies have become more resilient to external financial shocks. This paper assesses whether such resilience is broadly shared across emerging markets and developing economies by classifying them into three tiers based on economic size, income level, institutional strength, and financial integration. The analysis shows that first-tier emerging markets and developing economies have improved their external balance sheets and reduced dependence on official support. However, second- and third-tier emerging markets and developing economies have experienced growing external vulnerabilities since the global financial crisis, marked by rising external debt liabilities and declining foreign exchange reserves. Using a range of indicators, including sovereign defaults, arrears, partial defaults, and International Monetary Fund lending, the paper identifies episodes of external financial distress and shows that distress remains widespread among second- and third-tier emerging markets and developing economies. The empirical analysis confirms that key components of the net international investment position — especially external debt and foreign exchange reserves — predict the onset of external financial distress, with institutional quality shaping the impact. Weak institutions amplify risks, while strong institutions mitigate them. These findings highlight the importance of recognizing heterogeneity across emerging markets and developing economies, strengthening institutional quality alongside external balance-sheet management, and rebuilding buffers to safeguard against renewed global financial stress.
abstract_zh: 过去二十年间，许多新兴市场经济体对外部金融冲击的抵御能力有所增强。本文通过依据经济规模、收入水平、制度强度及金融一体化程度将新兴市场和发展中经济体划分为三个层级，评估这种韧性是否在这些经济体中广泛共享。分析显示，第一层级的新兴市场和发展中经济体改善了其外部资产负债表，并减少了对官方支持的依赖。然而，自全球金融危机以来，第二和第三层级的新兴市场和发展中经济体的外部脆弱性不断加剧，表现为外部债务负债上升和外汇储备下降。利用包括主权违约、拖欠、部分违约及国际货币基金组织贷款在内的一系列指标，本文识别了外部金融困境的发作情形，并表明困境在第二和第三层级的新兴市场和发展中经济体中依然普遍存在。实证分析证实，净国际投资头寸的关键组成部分——尤其是外部债务和外汇储备——能够预测外部金融困境的发生，而制度质量则影响这一作用。薄弱的制度会放大风险，而强大的制度则能缓解风险。这些发现强调了认识新兴市场和发展中经济体之间异质性的重要性，在加强外部资产负债表管理的同时提升制度质量，并重建缓冲以防范全球金融压力再度加剧。

title: The devil in the DeTail: assessing state-contingent tail effects of a releasable macroprudential capital buffer using a parsimonious agent-based framework
title_zh: 魔鬼在细节中：基于简约主体基框架评估可释放宏观审慎资本缓冲的状态依存的尾部效应
title_primary: 魔鬼在细节中：基于简约主体基框架评估可释放宏观审慎资本缓冲的状态依存的尾部效应
title_secondary: The devil in the DeTail: assessing state-contingent tail effects of a releasable macroprudential capital buffer using a parsimonious agent-based framework
authors: Enrico Minnella & Ana Pereira & Eugen Tereanu
official: 官方在线 2026-07-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper develops an agent-based framework (DeTail) to assess the state-contingent tail effects of releasable macroprudential capital buffers. The model features heterogeneous firms, households, and banks, and a single central bank, all interacting in a fully integrated, stock-flow consistent framework which generates endogenous credit cycles. Using this approach, we evaluate how time-varying capital requirements affect the time-varying distributions of credit growth, firm and household default rates, and bank losses along the credit cycle. Policy experiments show that releasing capital buffers during economic downturns preserves credit supply by improving risky (lower-tail) credit outcomes, reduces both households and firms defaults, and supports macro-financial resilience by limiting tail bank losses. At the same time, capital buffer accumulation during upturns imposes minimal costs and does not significantly constrain lending. These findings support the active use of releasable buffers to mitigate systemic risk and smooth credit cycles without weakening the banking system.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个基于主体的分析框架（DeTail），用以评估可释放宏观审慎资本缓冲的状态依存的尾部效应。该模型包含异质性企业、家庭和银行，以及单一中央银行，它们在一个完全整合、存量-流量一致的框架内相互作用，从而内生产生信贷周期。利用这一方法，我们评估了随时间变化的资本要求如何影响信贷增长、企业和家庭违约率以及银行损失在信贷周期中的时变分布。政策实验表明，在经济下行期间释放资本缓冲，通过改善高风险（下尾）信贷结果来维持信贷供给，降低家庭和企业违约率，并通过限制银行尾部损失增强宏观金融韧性。同时，在经济上行期积累资本缓冲的成本极小，且不会显著制约贷款活动。这些发现支持积极运用可释放缓冲来缓解系统性风险和平滑信贷周期，同时不削弱银行体系。

title: Peers matter more: Age-based herding in COVID-19 vaccination
title_zh: 同伴效应更重要：基于年龄的COVID-19疫苗接种从众行为
title_primary: 同伴效应更重要：基于年龄的COVID-19疫苗接种从众行为
title_secondary: Peers matter more: Age-based herding in COVID-19 vaccination
authors: Gil S. Epstein, Odelia Heizler, Osnat Israeli
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Herd behavior is a well-documented phenomenon in economics, yet little is known about whether people follow the general crowd or those who are most similar to them. This paper asks a simple but critical question: who do individuals really follow in a time of crisis? Using data from the European Social Survey combined with vaccination records across 15 countries, we examine how COVID-19 vaccination decisions were shaped by peers. We find that individuals’ willingness to vaccinate is driven far more strongly by their age-group peers than by the broader population, with the effect holding across most age groups. Moreover, our results reveal a U-shaped relationship between the share of vaccinated peers and individual vaccination intentions, suggesting that social norms reinforce peer effects once vaccination reaches a critical mass. These results highlight the perception that herd behavior is not just about the size of the herd; similarity is central to social learning and decision-making under uncertainty, with important implications for public health strategies and beyond. Regarding vaccination operations, these results indicate that mobilizing age-specific leaders, influencers, or social networks can help establish a herd within high-risk groups. More generally, as social learning appears to be most effective among individuals with shared characteristics, interventions designed to increase compliance may be more successful when targeted to specific peer groups rather than the general public.
abstract_zh: 羊群行为是经济学中一个已被充分记录的现象，然而关于人们是跟随大众还是跟随与自己最相似的人群，我们所知甚少。本文提出了一个简单但关键的问题：在危机时刻，个体究竟会跟随谁？利用欧洲社会调查数据结合15个国家的疫苗接种记录，我们考察了同伴如何影响COVID-19疫苗接种决策。研究发现，个体接种意愿受同龄群体影响远大于受更广泛人群的影响，且这一效应在大多数年龄组中均成立。此外，我们的结果揭示了已接种同伴比例与个体接种意愿之间存在U型关系，表明一旦疫苗接种达到临界规模，社会规范会强化同伴效应。这些结果凸显了一个认知：羊群行为不仅仅关乎群体的规模；相似性是社会学习和不确定性下决策的核心，对公共卫生策略及其他领域具有重要启示。就疫苗接种操作而言，这些结果表明，动员特定年龄的领导者、影响者或社交网络有助于在高风险群体中建立群体免疫。更广泛地说，由于社会学习在具有共同特征的个体之间最为有效，旨在提高遵从度的干预措施在针对特定同伴群体而非普通公众时可能更为成功。

title: Basic income versus fairness: redistribution with inactive agents
title_zh: 基本收入与公平：非活跃主体下的再分配
title_primary: 基本收入与公平：非活跃主体下的再分配
title_secondary: Basic income versus fairness: redistribution with inactive agents
authors: Antoine Germain
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: I study redistribution between inactive, unemployed, and employed agents who are heterogeneous in their preferences and their productive skills in the labor market and at home. The government considers that redistribution across skills is desirable, but redistribution across preferences is not: if everyone has the same preferences, equality is optimal, but if everyone has the same skills, laissez-faire is optimal. In turn, this leads to a simple sufficient statistic to assess any reform: any extra dollar of transfer should go to the agent whose consumption is the furthest below what she would have consumed if everyone had average skills. In high-income countries, the gap between the lowest consumption and the average production is empirically much larger in the labor market than among inactives. Hence, introducing an inactivity benefit, or basic income, would neither be welfare-improving nor optimal for that social welfare function, regardless of labor supply elasticities.
abstract_zh: 我研究的是在劳动力市场与家庭中，偏好和生产技能均存在异质性的非活跃、失业及就业个体之间的再分配问题。政府认为，跨技能再分配是可取的，但跨偏好再分配则不然：若所有人偏好相同，则平等为最优；若所有人技能相同，则自由放任为最优。由此，这引出了一个简单的充分统计量来评估任何改革：每一额外转移支付的美元应流向消费水平最低于其若拥有平均技能时所应消费水平的个体。在高收入国家中，最低消费与平均产出之间的差距在劳动力市场中实证上远大于非活跃群体。因此，引入非活跃津贴或基本收入，无论劳动供给弹性如何，既不会改善福利，也不符合该社会福利函数下的最优状态。

abstract: This paper examines several possible benefits that RTAs may confer on their partners, including credibility, signalling, bargaining power, insurance, and coordination. It assesses the necessary conditions for each of these candidates to work; gives stylized examples of specific types of policy where it might be applicable; examines real cases where the explanation might be relevant; and discusses their overall plausibility. It concludes by examining NAFTA and the Europe Agreements viewed in this light.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了区域贸易协定（RTAs）可能为其伙伴带来的若干潜在益处，包括可信度、信号传递、议价能力、保险机制及协调功能。研究评估了每种候选机制生效的必要条件；列举了可能适用的特定政策类型的典型范例；分析了相关解释可能适用的现实案例；并讨论了其整体合理性。最后，本文从这一视角审视了北美自由贸易协定（NAFTA）与欧洲协定。

title: Measuring the Value of Disability Insurance from Take-Up Decisions
title_zh: 从参保决策衡量伤残保险的价值
title_primary: 从参保决策衡量伤残保险的价值
title_secondary: Measuring the Value of Disability Insurance from Take-Up Decisions
authors: Haller, Andreas, Staubli, Stefan
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The central trade-off for designing Disability Insurance (DI) is between providing insurance to those in need while maintaining incentives to work. This paper develops a novel revealed-preference approach to identify the insurance value of DI benefits. We show that comparing the DI take-up response to a change in benefits versus a change in wages identifies the insurance value. Implementing our framework in Canada, we estimate that increasing DI benefits by $1 creates an additional disincentive cost of $0.60 but creates an insurance value of $2.20. Thus, our approach suggests that DI benefits are not overly generous in the Canadian context.
abstract_zh: 设计残疾保险（DI）的核心权衡在于，既要为有需要者提供保障，又要维持工作激励。本文提出了一种新颖的揭示偏好方法，用以识别DI福利的保险价值。我们证明，通过比较福利变化与工资变化对DI参保率的影响，可以识别出保险价值。在加拿大实施我们的框架后，估计每增加1美元DI福利，会产生0.60美元的额外抑制成本，但创造2.20美元的保险价值。因此，我们的方法表明，在加拿大背景下，DI福利并未过度慷慨。

title: When Can Less Be More? Inducing Dealer Responses in RFQ Platforms
title_zh: 何时少即是多？在RFQ平台中诱导交易商反应
title_primary: 何时少即是多？在RFQ平台中诱导交易商反应
title_secondary: When Can Less Be More? Inducing Dealer Responses in RFQ Platforms
authors: Bart Zhou Yueshen, Junyuan Zou
official: 官方在线 2026-07-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We show in a model of RFQ trading that customers may admit only a few dealers, even when more are available, to induce maximum liquidity supply—“less can be more.” The number of admitted dealers is pinned down by a competition elasticity, shaped by dealers’ cost to respond to RFQs. For example, higher search (operating) costs increase (reduce) admitted dealers. A social planner would mandate even fewer dealers than the market outcome, because customers induce excessive dealer competition. The model predicts endogenous market power, yields implications for regulation and design of electronic platforms, and speaks to customer-dealer interactions under market stress.
abstract_zh: 我们在一个询价（RFQ）交易模型中表明，即使有更多交易商可用，客户也可能仅接纳少数几家，以诱导最大化的流动性供给——“少即是多”。接纳的交易商数量由竞争弹性决定，这一弹性受交易商响应询价的成本影响。例如，较高的搜寻（运营）成本会增加（减少）接纳的交易商数量。社会规划者会规定比市场结果更少的交易商数量，因为客户会引发过度的交易商竞争。该模型预测了内生市场力量，为电子平台的监管与设计提供了启示，并探讨了市场压力下的客户与交易商互动。

title: The inflationary effects of global supply chain shocks: Evidence from Swedish microdata
title_zh: 全球供应链冲击的通胀效应：来自瑞典微观数据的证据
title_primary: 全球供应链冲击的通胀效应：来自瑞典微观数据的证据
title_secondary: The inflationary effects of global supply chain shocks: Evidence from Swedish microdata
authors: David Finck, Mathias Klein, Peter Tillmann
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We compile a unique dataset linking micro price data underlying the official Swedish producer price index with administrative firm level data and provide new evidence on the inflationary effects of global supply chain shocks. For identification, we interact exogenous shocks to global supply chains, obtained through a VAR model, with firm-specific import shares. Shocks to global supply chains lead to a significant and persistent increase in producer prices with a peak response after two years. Importantly, average responses mask heterogeneous responses across firms. Relatively larger firms, firms with lower labor costs and a higher market share raise prices more strongly.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个独特的数据集，将瑞典官方生产者价格指数背后的微观价格数据与行政企业层面数据相结合，为全球供应链冲击的通胀效应提供了新证据。为进行识别，我们通过VAR模型获取的全球供应链外生冲击与企业特定的进口份额进行交互作用。全球供应链冲击导致生产者价格显著且持续上升，峰值反应出现在两年后。重要的是，平均反应掩盖了企业间的异质性反应。相对较大的企业、劳动成本较低且市场份额较高的企业，其价格上调幅度更大。

title: The Summer Drop in Female Employment
title_zh: 女性就业的夏季下降
title_primary: 女性就业的夏季下降
title_secondary: The Summer Drop in Female Employment
authors: Brendan M. Price, Melanie Wasserman
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We provide the first systematic account of summer declines in women’s labor market activity. From May to July, U.S. women’s employment-to-population ratio declines 1.1 p.p., whereas men’s rises; women’s hours worked fall 9.8%, twice the decline among men. School closures for summer break provide a unifying explanation. The summer drop aligns with cross-state differences in school closure timing, is concentrated among mothers with young school-aged children, and coincides with increased time spent on child care. Gender differences both within and across jobs explain gender gaps in summer exits from employment. Women’s summer work interruptions contribute to gender gaps in pay.
abstract_zh: 我们首次系统性地揭示了夏季女性劳动力市场活跃度下降的现象。从5月到7月，美国女性就业人口比率下降1.1个百分点，而男性则有所上升；女性工作时长下降9.8%，降幅是男性的两倍。学校暑期放假提供了一个统一的解释。夏季就业下降与各州学校放假时间的差异一致，主要集中在有学龄儿童的母亲群体中，并与育儿时间增加相吻合。职业内部及跨职业的性别差异解释了夏季退出就业的性别差距。女性夏季工作中断进一步加剧了性别薪酬差距。

title: The Unobserved Returns to Entrepreneurship
title_zh: 创业的未观测回报
title_primary: 创业的未观测回报
title_secondary: The Unobserved Returns to Entrepreneurship
authors: Sarada
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper presents an alternative perspective to a longstanding empirical puzzle: that most entrepreneurs persevere despite persistently low earnings. Because entrepreneurial earnings are notoriously difficult to measure, I approach the question from an expenditure angle. I look at how switching into self-employment corresponds to changes in reported earnings versus expenditure. Using 45 years of longitudinal data, I find that individuals report earning 27.7% less in self-employment, while spending 3.8% more. This household expenditure premium accrues with entrepreneurial experience and is not offset by lower savings or longer work hours. The results hold in highly educated and incorporated business owner subsamples.
abstract_zh: 本文为长期存在的实证谜题——多数企业家在持续低收益下仍坚持创业——提供了新的解释视角。鉴于创业收益难以精确衡量，本文从支出角度切入研究，考察转向自雇就业如何影响报告收入与支出的变化。基于45年纵向数据研究发现：个体在自雇状态下报告收入降低27.7%，但支出反而增加3.8%。这种家庭支出溢价随创业经验积累而递增，且未被储蓄减少或工时延长所抵消。该结论在高等教育群体及注册企业主子样本中依然稳健成立。

title: Full-day school programs and higher education: Evidence from Peru
title_zh: 全日制学校项目与高等教育：来自秘鲁的证据
title_primary: 全日制学校项目与高等教育：来自秘鲁的证据
title_secondary: Full-day school programs and higher education: Evidence from Peru
authors: Vania Bitia Salas García, Germán Vega Acuña, Stefani Seminario Solano, Sinthia Morales Mendoza
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Full-day school programs aim to promote development by improving students’ learning outcomes. We estimate the impact of Peru’s full-day secondary school reform, Jornada Escolar Completa (JEC), on higher education attainment. Using data from the Young Lives Study, we construct a grouped-sibling sample linking younger siblings who could attend JEC secondary schools with their older siblings who did not attend. The identification strategy relies on within-household variation and a difference-in-differences framework comparing changes in higher education attainment between households affected and not affected by the JEC program. We find that JEC increases the likelihood of pursuing higher education, with effects concentrated in technical rather than university studies. Our findings also suggest larger gains among students from disadvantaged backgrounds, pointing to the potential of JEC to narrow inequalities in access to higher education. Time-use data show that JEC students remain engaged in learning, with no increase in absenteeism or decline in study time at home. Rather, they compensate for longer school days by cutting back on leisure and work activities. Overall, the evidence indicates that the JEC program increases educational attainment, with extended instructional time likely being one contributing factor among other improvements in school resources. JEC’s effects on upward mobility, however, may remain limited without complementary measures that ease access to university education.
abstract_zh: 全日制学校项目旨在通过提升学生的学习成果来促进发展。我们评估了秘鲁的全日制中学改革——“完整学校日”（JEC）对高等教育入学率的影响。利用“青年生活研究”数据，我们构建了一个分组兄弟姐妹样本，将可能就读JEC中学的弟弟妹妹与未就读该项目的哥哥姐姐进行配对。识别策略依赖于家庭内部差异，并采用双重差分框架，比较受JEC项目影响与未受影响家庭之间高等教育入学率的变化。我们发现，JEC提高了追求高等教育的可能性，其效应主要集中在技术类而非大学类学习上。我们的研究结果还表明，来自不利背景的学生获益更大，这指向JEC在缩小高等教育入学机会不平等方面具有潜力。时间使用数据显示，JEC学生持续参与学习，缺勤率未增加，在家学习时间也未减少。相反，他们通过减少休闲和工作活动来补偿更长的在校时间。总体而言，证据表明JEC项目提升了教育成就，其中延长教学时间可能是学校资源其他改进中的一个促成因素。然而，若无配套措施便利大学入学途径，JEC对向上流动的影响可能仍然有限。

title: Exact inference from finite market data
title_zh: 有限市场数据的精确推断
title_primary: 有限市场数据的精确推断
title_secondary: Exact inference from finite market data
authors: F. Kübler, R. Malhotra, H. Polemarchakis
official: 官方在线 2026-07-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We derive conditions for individual choices and $$ \epsilon $$ ϵ -equilibrium prices to be inferred from a finite set of market data in the following sense: Although potential observations are infinite, inference can be attained and known to have been attained after a finite number of observations. While we first examine the case of observations on an individual’s demand at different prices and incomes, our primary focus is on equilibrium, where only profiles of individual endowments and associated equilibrium prices are observable. Our main result is that finite inference is possible in the equilibrium setting if one wants to infer either individual choices or the $$ \epsilon $$ ϵ -equilibrium correspondence.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文推导了从有限市场数据推断个体选择与ε-均衡价格的条件，其含义如下：尽管潜在观测数据是无限的，但经过有限次观测后，推断不仅能够实现，且可被确认为已完成。我们首先考察了不同价格与收入水平下个体需求观测的情形，但主要关注均衡状态——此时仅能观测到个体禀赋组合及其对应的均衡价格。核心结论是：若需推断个体选择或ε-均衡对应关系，则在均衡框架下有限次推断是可行的。

title: Literature Review and Evidence Aggregation: a Toolkit for Applied Micro
title_zh: 文献综述与证据汇总：应用微观经济学工具包
title_primary: 文献综述与证据汇总：应用微观经济学工具包
title_secondary: Literature Review and Evidence Aggregation: a Toolkit for Applied Micro
authors: Peter Ganong, Avik Garg, Maximilian Kasy
official: 官方在线月份 2026-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Consider an analyst interested in predicting the size of an effect. She has identified a set of prior published studies of similar effects. We provide a toolkit for (i) summarizing the prior literature, (ii) making predictions of effects in new contexts, and (iii) correcting for the bias from selectivity in the prior literature. We illustrate these methods with empirical examples from labor, public, behavioral, environmental, and development economics. Some of the tools are relevant even when only three prior studies are available. We show how it is possible to use covariates to transparently make predictions for a new context by reweighting prior estimates. The mean effect—after correcting for selectivity—is between 12% and 21% of the simple mean in our empirical examples. We conclude with a cookbook for practitioners producing meta-analyses.
abstract_zh: 考虑一位分析师，其目标是预测某一效应的大小。她已确定一组关于类似效应的先前已发表研究。我们提供了一套工具包，用于：(i) 总结先前文献，(ii) 预测新情境下的效应，以及 (iii) 纠正先前文献中选择性偏差带来的偏误。我们通过来自劳动经济学、公共经济学、行为经济学、环境经济学和发展经济学的实证案例来展示这些方法。即便仅有三项先前研究可用，部分工具仍具相关性。我们展示了如何通过重新加权先前估计值，利用协变量透明地预测新情境下的效应。在我们的实证案例中，经选择性偏差校正后的平均效应，仅为简单均值的12%至21%。最后，我们为从事元分析的研究者提供了一份实践指南。

title: Persuasion with Coarse Communication
title_zh: 粗沟通中的说服
title_primary: 粗沟通中的说服
title_secondary: Persuasion with Coarse Communication
authors: Yunus C. Aybas, Eray Turkel
official: 官方在线 2026-06-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In many expert–decision maker settings, information is richer than the language used to convey it. Motivated by this communication friction, we study Bayesian persuasion when the sender is constrained to use k messages. We show that the sender’s value is given by a k -point analogue of concavification, which we call k -concavification. An optimal information structure can be chosen with affinely independent posterior support, allowing the problem to be reduced to a lower-dimensional persuasion problem and then solved by standard concavification. We derive a tight bound on the value of communication capacity that applies to general persuasion games: the gain from a $$(k+1)$$ ( k + 1 ) st message is at most $$2/(k-1)$$ 2 / ( k - 1 ) times the value attainable with k messages. Finally, we solve a class of belief-threshold games in which the receiver chooses between a safe default and several risky actions, the sender gets zero from the default and the same positive payoff from any risky action, and a risky action is taken only when the corresponding posterior probability exceeds a threshold. We characterize the optimal coarse information structure, derive comparative statics in the prior and the threshold, and extend the analysis to heterogeneous thresholds and heterogeneous sender values across risky actions.
abstract_zh: 摘要 在许多专家与决策者互动的场景中，信息本身比用于传递信息的语言更为丰富。受这种沟通摩擦的启发，我们研究了当发送者被限制使用k条消息时的贝叶斯说服问题。我们证明，发送者的价值由凹化概念的k点对应物给出，我们称之为k-凹化。最优信息结构可以选择具有仿射独立后验支撑的形式，从而将问题简化为低维说服问题，并通过标准凹化方法求解。我们推导了适用于一般说服博弈的沟通容量价值的紧界：第(k+1)条消息带来的增益最多为k条消息可实现价值的2/(k-1)倍。最后，我们求解了一类信念阈值博弈，其中接收者在安全默认选项与多个风险行动之间进行选择，发送者从默认选项中获得零收益，从任何风险行动中获得相同的正收益，且仅当相应的后验概率超过阈值时才采取风险行动。我们刻画了最优粗糙信息结构，推导了关于先验和阈值的比较静态分析，并将分析扩展至风险行动具有异质性阈值和异质性发送者价值的情形。

title: COVID-19 and peer relationships: Insights from classroom social networks
title_zh: COVID-19与同伴关系：来自课堂社交网络的启示
title_primary: COVID-19与同伴关系：来自课堂社交网络的启示
title_secondary: COVID-19 and peer relationships: Insights from classroom social networks
authors: Yusuf Agus, Betul Turkum
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In the spring of 2020, as the COVID-19 pandemic swept across the globe, governments implemented drastic containment measures, including widespread school closures that deprived millions of children of their primary social environment—the classroom. To understand how classroom peer relationships differed between the pre-pandemic and pandemic cohorts, we leverage social network data from 3rd and 4th-grade students in Turkish primary schools, comparing pre-pandemic and pandemic cohorts across three relationship types: friendship, academic support, and emotional support. We document opposing changes across network types: friendship isolation increased by 22%, while academic support nominations rose by 20%. These improvements in academic support were driven entirely by native students; refugee students faced deterioration in both friendship and academic support networks. Our findings show that large-scale disruptions can reshape peer relationships in complex ways, underscoring the vital role of the classroom in building social capital.
abstract_zh: 2020年春季，随着COVID-19疫情席卷全球，各国政府实施了严格的防控措施，包括大规模关闭学校，使数百万儿童失去了他们主要的社会环境——教室。为了了解疫情前后学生群体中课堂同伴关系的差异，我们利用土耳其小学三年级和四年级学生的社交网络数据，比较了疫情前后群体在三种关系类型中的差异：友谊、学业支持和情感支持。我们发现不同网络类型呈现出相反的变化：友谊孤立现象增加了22%，而学业支持提名则上升了20%。学业支持的改善完全由本地学生驱动；难民学生在友谊和学业支持网络方面均面临恶化。我们的研究结果表明，大规模干扰可以以复杂的方式重塑同伴关系，凸显了课堂在构建社会资本中的关键作用。

title: A Static Capital Buffer is Hard To Beat
title_zh: 静态资本缓冲难以被超越
title_primary: 静态资本缓冲难以被超越
title_secondary: A Static Capital Buffer is Hard To Beat
authors: Matthew B. Canzoneri, Behzad T. Diba, Luca Guerrieri, Arsenii Mishin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In a model with endogenous risk-taking, deposit insurance and limited liability may lead banks to make risky loans that are socially inefficient. Capital requirements can prevent excessive risk-taking at the cost of reducing liquidity-producing bank deposits. A policy that sets capital requirements just high enough to prevent excessive risk-taking will move capital requirements pro-, counter-, or a-cyclically depending on the shock source. However, such a policy requires full knowledge of all the shocks hitting the economy and is not implementable. Simple rules that respond to cyclical conditions---in line with Basel III guidance---perform poorly, whereas a small static capital buffer can do much better.
abstract_zh: 在内生风险承担模型中，存款保险与有限责任可能导致银行发放社会效率低下的高风险贷款。资本充足要求能够以降低流动性创造型银行存款为代价，防止过度风险承担。若将资本充足要求设定为恰好足以遏制过度风险承担的水平，该政策将根据冲击来源呈现顺周期、逆周期或非周期特征。然而，此类政策要求完全掌握冲击经济的全部因素，实际中并不可行。符合《巴塞尔协议III》指引的周期性调节型简单规则表现欠佳，而小规模静态资本缓冲却能取得显著更优效果。

title: Beliefs About the Economy are Excessively Sensitive to Household-Level Shocks: Evidence from Linked Survey and Administrative Data
title_zh: 家庭层面冲击对经济信念的过度敏感：基于关联调查与行政数据的证据
title_primary: 家庭层面冲击对经济信念的过度敏感：基于关联调查与行政数据的证据
title_secondary: Beliefs About the Economy are Excessively Sensitive to Household-Level Shocks: Evidence from Linked Survey and Administrative Data
authors: Dmitry Taubinsky, Luigi Butera, Matteo Saccarola, Chen Lian
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study how people’s beliefs about the economy covary with household-level events, utilizing a unique link between Danish administrative data and a large-scale survey of consumer expectations. We find that compared to actual inflation, people’s inflation forecasts covary much more strongly (and negatively) with both recently realized household income changes and measures of expected future household income changes. We formally establish that these findings are stark deviations from the Bayesian rational expectations benchmark. Similar results hold for perceptions of past inflation (“backcasts” ), suggesting that imperfect recall is a key mechanism for biased forecasts. Building on this, a series of additional tests, some of which utilize data on adverse health events, suggests that the forecast biases are at least partly due to affect-cued recall. That is, negative (positive) household-level events cue negative (positive) recollections, which lead to pessimistic (optimistic) forecasts.
abstract_zh: 我们利用丹麦行政数据与大规模消费者预期调查之间的独特关联，研究了人们对经济的信念如何随家庭层面事件而变化。研究发现，相较于实际通胀率，人们的通胀预测与近期已实现的家庭收入变化以及预期的未来家庭收入变化指标之间存在显著更强的负向协动关系。我们正式证明，这些发现与贝叶斯理性预期基准存在显著偏离。类似结果也适用于对过去通胀的感知（"回溯预测"），表明不完美回忆是导致预测偏差的关键机制。在此基础上，一系列附加检验（部分利用不良健康事件数据）表明，预测偏差至少部分源于情感线索回忆——即负面（正面）家庭层面事件会触发负面（正面）回忆，进而导致悲观（乐观）预测。

title: How to grow an invoicing currency: Micro evidence from Argentina
title_zh: 如何培育发票货币：来自阿根廷的微观证据
title_primary: 如何培育发票货币：来自阿根廷的微观证据
title_secondary: How to grow an invoicing currency: Micro evidence from Argentina
authors: Felipe Benguria, Dennis Novy
official: 官方在线 2026-06-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the internationalization of the Chinese renminbi (RMB) leveraging a unique policy experiment. In 2023, amid a dollar shortage, Argentina expanded a currency swap line with China. The share of imports from China invoiced in RMB surged rapidly, displacing the dollar, which had previously accounted for virtually all invoicing. Following the presidential election of late 2023, as the dollar shortage eased, invoicing in RMB declined. We explore the mechanisms behind this pattern, using firm-level data on imports, bank-firm loan relationships, and bank balance sheets. We find that banks played a key role. Firms with pre-existing relationships to banks with limited US dollar loans were more likely to switch to RMB. In addition, firms borrowing from a Chinese state-owned bank were more likely to use RMB. We also document firm-level spillovers, with RMB use for imports from China increasing RMB use for imports from other countries. Finally, firms switching to RMB saw increased total imports.
abstract_zh: 我们利用一项独特的政策实验来研究人民币的国际使用。2023年，在美元短缺的背景下，阿根廷扩大了与中国的货币互换额度。从中国进口的商品以人民币计价的比例迅速上升，取代了此前几乎占据全部计价份额的美元。随着2023年末总统大选后美元短缺状况缓解，人民币计价比例有所下降。我们利用企业层面的进口数据、银行与企业间的贷款关系以及银行资产负债表，探讨了这一现象背后的机制。研究发现，银行在其中发挥了关键作用。与美元贷款有限的银行有既有关系的企业更倾向于转向使用人民币。此外，从中国国有银行借款的企业也更可能使用人民币。我们还记录了企业层面的溢出效应，即从中国进口时使用人民币会增加从其他国家进口时使用人民币的可能性。最后，转向使用人民币的企业总进口额有所增加。

title: Macroeconomic Impacts of Industrial Hemp Expansion in the United States: A General Equilibrium Analysis
title_primary: Macroeconomic Impacts of Industrial Hemp Expansion in the United States: A General Equilibrium Analysis
authors: Osanya, Jessica, Reimer, Jeffrey J.
source: Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-06-03 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study analyzes macro-economic aspects of industrial hemp in the U.S. economy with a focus on fiber products. Potential adoption of hemp is evaluated using a general equilibrium model. A policy such as a mandate could induce the use of hemp in production sectors involving fiber, paper, concrete, and building materials. This would cause a very slight decrease in overall societal welfare due to inefficiencies caused by allocations of resources away from market-based choices. However, the hemp-producing crops sector would expand by four percent and create 33,000 to 136,000 hemp-adjacent jobs depending on the policy scenario.

title: Choosing (not) to choose: Uncovering intrinsic preferences for choice autonomy
title_zh: 选择（不）选择：揭示对选择自主权的内在偏好
title_primary: 选择（不）选择：揭示对选择自主权的内在偏好

authors: Jana Freundt, Holger Herz, Leander Kopp
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Personal autonomy has been argued to be fundamental to well-being and is often discussed as an important driver of economic and political behavior. However, preferences for autonomy remain poorly understood. We propose a novel elicitation method for an individual’s intrinsic preference for choice autonomy that fully controls for instrumental value benefits of choice. We show that, while a majority of subjects in our experiment display a preference for choice autonomy, a significant minority is averse to their own choice.
abstract_zh: 个人自主性被认为是福祉的基础，并常被讨论为经济和政治行为的重要驱动力。然而，对自主性的偏好仍知之甚少。我们提出了一种新颖的诱导方法，用于评估个体对选择自主性的内在偏好，该方法完全控制了选择工具性价值的好处。我们表明，在我们的实验中，虽然大多数受试者表现出对选择自主性的偏好，但相当一部分少数群体却对自己的选择感到厌恶。

title: Diamonds aren’t forever: manufactured substitutes, irreversible substitution, and the new resource curse
title_zh: 钻石并非永恒：人造替代品、不可逆替代与新资源诅咒
title_primary: 钻石并非永恒：人造替代品、不可逆替代与新资源诅咒
title_secondary: Diamonds aren’t forever: manufactured substitutes, irreversible substitution, and the new resource curse
authors: Dwayne Woods
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: When technological substitutes reduce scarcity rents, resource-dependent countries face a timing challenge that traditional resource-curse models do not account for. This paper develops a dynamic political economy model of exit timing and calibrates it to Botswana’s exposure to laboratory-grown diamonds (LGDs). Observable empirical data—including rapid LGD adoption, persistent price declines, and Botswana’s reliance on diamond revenues—informs key parameters and yields policy-relevant insights. Recent market changes underscore this mechanism: Botswana’s diamond inventories reached 12 million carats in 2025, nearly twice the historical levels, while mineral revenues declined by about 60 percent compared to previous averages. The model demonstrates that, with irreversible substitution and varying adjustment speeds, common rent-defense strategies such as cartel coordination, inventory management, and vertical integration are less effective than earlier contraction and faster diversification. Calibration suggests a transition period of roughly 12–15 years; delaying adjustment by five years can reduce the present value of resource wealth by approximately 20–30 percent. The analysis uncovers a distinct form of the resource curse: failing to complete structural transformation before technological substitution renders resource rents obsolete.
abstract_zh: 当技术替代品减少资源稀缺租金时，资源依赖型国家面临着一个传统资源诅咒模型未能解释的时机挑战。本文构建了一个关于退出时机的动态政治经济学模型，并将其校准至博茨瓦纳对实验室培育钻石（LGDs）的暴露程度。可观测的经验数据——包括LGD的快速普及、持续的价格下跌以及博茨瓦纳对钻石收入的依赖——为关键参数提供了信息，并产生了具有政策相关性的洞见。近期市场变化凸显了这一机制：2025年，博茨瓦纳的钻石库存达到1200万克拉，几乎是历史水平的两倍，而矿产收入较以往平均水平下降了约60%。模型表明，在不可逆替代和不同调整速度的情况下，卡特尔协调、库存管理和纵向一体化等常见的租金防御策略，其效果不如更早收缩和更快多元化。校准结果显示，转型期约为12至15年；延迟调整五年可能使资源财富的现值减少约20%至30%。分析揭示了一种独特的资源诅咒形式：在技术替代使资源租金过时之前未能完成结构转型。

title: Weather or climate? A new perspective on temperature shocks
title_zh: 天气还是气候？温度冲击的新视角
title_primary: 天气还是气候？温度冲击的新视角
title_secondary: Weather or climate? A new perspective on temperature shocks
authors: Nooman Rebei
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Prevailing research suggests that climate change disproportionately burdens emerging markets and developing economies with larger output losses compared to advanced economies, positing that colder regions are less impacted than their warmer counterparts. This study revisits the empirical relationship between temperature fluctuations and real growth, with a novel focus on differentiating between transitory versus permanent temperature shifts, aligning naturally with the definitions of weather and climate change, respectively. Our findings reveal that richer and colder economies appear less affected by weather shocks, whereas this pattern reverses for climate change disturbances, challenging the conclusions of previous studies.
abstract_zh: 现有研究普遍认为，气候变化对新兴市场和发展中经济体的产出损失影响更为严重，相较于发达经济体，寒冷地区所受影响较小。本研究重新审视了温度波动与实际增长之间的实证关系，创新性地聚焦于区分暂时性与永久性温度变化，这自然对应了天气与气候变化的定义。我们的研究结果显示，较富裕且较寒冷的经济体对天气冲击的影响似乎较小，但在气候变化干扰方面，这一模式发生逆转，从而对先前研究的结论提出了挑战。

title: Mapping Circular Bioeconomy Research in Agrifood Systems: Perspectives From Australia and New Zealand
title_zh: 农业食品系统中循环生物经济研究的图谱：来自澳大利亚和新西兰的视角
title_primary: 农业食品系统中循环生物经济研究的图谱：来自澳大利亚和新西兰的视角
title_secondary: Mapping Circular Bioeconomy Research in Agrifood Systems: Perspectives From Australia and New Zealand
authors: Maja Arsic, Tiffany McIntyre
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Growing awareness of unsustainable linear production, consumption and waste economic models is prompting exploration of circular economy and bioeconomy models. The ‘circular bioeconomy’, sitting at the nexus of these concepts, is of particular importance to agrifood systems, which play a critical role in producing biologically based materials and services, and converting waste streams into safe and sustainable resources. A systematic mapping protocol was applied to develop a broad overview of ‘circular bioeconomy’ research in Australian and New Zealand agrifood systems. Sixty‐nine full‐text publications were coded to catalogue studies by domain, methodology, and categories of inputs, technologies and products (for biophysical studies). The circular bioeconomy is an emerging research area, currently experiencing inconsistent definitions of key terms, a high proportion of review papers, and limited engagement with key concepts in certain research areas. There were key differences between Australian and New Zealand research, particularly in terms of science domain, research methodology and dominant perspectives on key circular economy and bioeconomy principles. Recommendations for future studies include standardising circular bioeconomy definitions, increasing social science applications, mapping potential circular bioeconomy assessment tools, and applying circular bioeconomy principles and guidelines to develop cross‐sectoral strategies. Coordinated research efforts can support circular bioeconomy approaches for sustainable agrifood systems in Australia and New Zealand.
abstract_zh: 摘要 对不可持续的线性生产、消费和废弃物经济模式日益增长的认识，正促使人们探索循环经济和生物经济模式。位于这些概念交汇点的“循环生物经济”，对农业食品系统尤为重要，该系统在产生基于生物的材料和服务，以及将废物流转化为安全可持续资源方面发挥着关键作用。采用系统映射协议，对澳大利亚和新西兰农业食品系统中的“循环生物经济”研究进行了广泛概述。对69篇全文出版物进行了编码，按领域、方法论以及输入、技术和产品类别（针对生物物理研究）对研究进行分类。循环生物经济是一个新兴研究领域，目前面临关键术语定义不一致、综述论文比例高以及某些研究领域对关键概念参与有限的问题。澳大利亚与新西兰的研究存在显著差异，特别是在科学领域、研究方法以及对循环经济和生物经济关键原则的主导视角方面。未来研究的建议包括标准化循环生物经济定义、增加社会科学应用、绘制潜在的循环生物经济评估工具，以及应用循环生物经济原则和指南制定跨部门战略。协调一致的研究努力可支持澳大利亚和新西兰可持续农业食品系统的循环生物经济方法。

title: The Causal Effects of Confidence Awareness on Financial Literacy and Behaviour
title_zh: 信心意识对金融素养与行为的因果效应
title_primary: 信心意识对金融素养与行为的因果效应
title_secondary: The Causal Effects of Confidence Awareness on Financial Literacy and Behaviour
authors: Ines Lee, Ana Lleó-Bono, Christopher Rauh, Eileen Tipoe
official: 官方在线 2025-10-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines whether increasing individuals’ awareness of their own confidence can influence financial behaviour. In a pre-registered online experiment with nearly 3,000 U.S. adults, we test the effects of a novel metacognitive intervention: personalised feedback on implicit confidence about one’s financial abilities, as measured by a custom Implicit Association Test (IAT), paired with an explanation of the importance of self-confidence in financial abilities. Treated participants show a significant reduction in “don’t know” responses on financial literacy tests and their performance in an incentivised investment task significantly improves: treated participants are less likely to make clearly dominated choices, more likely to select efficient allocations, and choose portfolios closer to the efficient frontier. These effects persist two weeks later in a follow-up survey with obfuscated framing. Heterogeneity analyses show stronger effects for females and for participants who understate their confidence (i.e. whose reported confidence is lower than what their IAT suggests). Keywords: Confidence, Confidence awareness, Personal finance, Financial literacy, Survey experiment.
abstract_zh: 本文探究提升个体对自身信心的认知是否会影响其金融行为。在一项针对近3000名美国成年人的预注册在线实验中，我们测试了一种新型元认知干预措施的效果：通过定制化内隐联想测验（IAT）测量个体对自身金融能力的内隐信心，并辅以关于金融能力自信心重要性的解释，向参与者提供个性化反馈。接受干预的参与者在金融素养测试中回答“不知道”的比例显著降低，且其在激励性投资任务中的表现显著改善：他们更少做出明显被支配的选择，更倾向于选择有效配置方案，并选择更接近有效前沿的投资组合。这些效应在两周后以模糊化框架进行的追踪调查中依然持续存在。异质性分析显示，该效应在女性参与者以及低估自身信心（即自我报告信心低于IAT测量结果）的参与者中更为显著。关键词：信心，信心认知，个人理财，金融素养，调查实验。

title: Social inequality in mortality in rural Spain (1860–2010): The role of education and human capital
title_zh: 西班牙农村死亡率的社会不平等（1860–2010）：教育与人力资本的作用
title_primary: 西班牙农村死亡率的社会不平等（1860–2010）：教育与人力资本的作用
title_secondary: Social inequality in mortality in rural Spain (1860–2010): The role of education and human capital
authors: Víctor A. Luque de Haro, Francisco J. Marco‐Gracia
official: 官方在线 2025-10-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study investigates the role of education in shaping social disparities in mortality in rural Spain over the past 150 years. On the basis of individual‐level life‐course microdata on around 40,000 individuals, it examines variables such as socio‐economic status, age at death, and various family, cultural, and environmental factors. An event history analysis tracks the lifespans of all individuals who died at age 25 or older in 17 villages. Our findings indicate that literacy and higher levels of education were positively associated with longevity. This beneficial effect extends in multiple directions: human capital not only enhanced individual longevity, but also improved the survival and wellbeing of children and parents. Therefore, investing in one's own or one's children's education boosted not only personal longevity, but also the wellbeing of those around them. The reasons behind these patterns could be diverse, including the ability to adapt lifestyles to medical and health advancements (evidenced by the intensified effect of literacy from the late nineteenth century when hygiene knowledge became widespread) and higher purchasing power, together with higher skill levels and less physically demanding occupations.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了过去150年间教育在塑造西班牙农村地区死亡率社会差异中的作用。基于约40,000名个体的生命历程微观数据，本研究考察了社会经济地位、死亡年龄以及各种家庭、文化和环境因素等变量。一项事件史分析追踪了17个村庄中所有在25岁及以上去世个体的寿命。我们的研究结果表明，识字能力和更高水平的教育与长寿呈正相关。这一有益影响体现在多个方面：人力资本不仅增强了个体寿命，还改善了子女及父母双方的生存状况与福祉。因此，投资于自身或子女的教育不仅提升了个人的长寿水平，也增进了周围人的福祉。这些模式背后的原因可能多种多样，包括适应医疗和健康进步的生活方式调整能力（从19世纪末卫生知识普及后识字效应增强可见一斑），以及更高的购买力，加之更高的技能水平和较少的体力劳动职业。

title_zh: 性别特定最低工资立法的经济学分析
title_primary: 性别特定最低工资立法的经济学分析
title_secondary: The Economics of Gender-Specific Minimum Wage Legislation
authors: Riccardo Marchingiglio, Michael Poyker
official: 官方在线 2024-10-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using full count US census data, we study the impact of early twentieth-century state-industry-specific minimum wage laws that primarily targeted female employees. Our triple-difference estimates suggest a null impact of the minimum wage laws, potentially reflecting disemployment effects and the positive selection bias of the workers remaining in the labor force. When comparing county-industry trends between counties straddling state borders, female employment is lower by around 3.1% in affected county-industry cells. We further investigate the implications for own-wage elasticity of labor demand as a function of cross-industry concentration, the channels of substitution between men and women, and heterogeneity by marital status.
abstract_zh: 利用美国人口普查全量数据，本文研究了20世纪初主要针对女性雇员的州-行业特定最低工资法的影响。三重差分估计结果表明，最低工资法的影响为零，这可能反映了就业抑制效应以及留在劳动力队伍中的工人存在的正向选择偏差。通过比较州界两侧县-行业层面的趋势，受影响县-行业单元的女性就业率下降约3.1%。我们进一步探讨了劳动力需求的自工资弹性如何随跨行业集中度变化、男女替代渠道以及婚姻状况异质性。
